attributes.reason: C-0193/C-0202 assert cluster-wide admission posture (privileged / HostProcess containers) against bare Namespace manifests. The stack's own kyverno-policies component IS that admission control (verify-platform-signature), the github-arc namespace is labelled PSS privileged on purpose (the dind sidecar runs privileged, isolated on dedicated tainted capacity), and a Namespace object cannot itself satisfy the control.
